blurb: Kaytea Petro is an artists and educator who co-owns an art space in the Polk-Gulch / Russian Hill neighborhoods of San Francisco, California. Gallery-O-Rama brings events, art shows, comedy nights, and ceramic classes to the Russian Hill / Polk-Gulch neighborhood on Polk street san Francisco.
